review.review_method: independent text/code/evidence audit; no source edits, no real-save writes, no image inspection or image-tool calls; root performed visual image inspection

reviewer_agents.bound_scope: Batch J correctness, tests, evidence provenance, version/save safety, counterplay/pacing conclusions, and text/code visual contracts

findings.title: Anti-dive improvement is not causal evidence for the selected guard
findings.required_action: No blocker while reports attribute the gain to species/formation/resources. Obtain a paired enabled/disabled counterfactual before any future claim that guard independently wins games.
findings.re_review_condition: A causal guard claim requires a predeclared held-out contrast with identical build/resources and a non-zero paired outcome/mechanism effect attributable to guard selection.

findings.title: Natural-end statistical lower bound does not reach 90%
findings.required_action: No blocker for the stated observed-rate screen. If a statistical 90% lower-bound gate is later required, increase independent formal N or use a predeclared sequential boundary design.
findings.re_review_condition: A lower-bound acceptance claim needs a fresh predeclared sample whose Wilson 95% lower bound is at least 90%.

findings.title: Fixed squads do not establish acquisition, full-run adaptive use, or human timing
findings.required_action: Keep fixed-squad and automatic-time claims scoped. Add full-session adaptive acquisition and human three-key timing evidence in the next package.
findings.re_review_condition: Do not claim live acquisition frequency, all-roster balance, or D12 human-duration acceptance without full runs and human timing samples.

findings.title: Archived Phase II JSON retains a legacy phase-label mismatch
findings.required_action: No rerun needed: mode, ruleset, arms, README, and manifest disambiguate the archived v2 artifact. Prefer the corrected phase field for all future artifacts.
findings.re_review_condition: Any future Phase II artifact must carry the supplied phase value; do not rewrite the archived formal raw data retroactively.

findings.title: Visual acceptance is root-inspected PC evidence, not independent art or hardware acceptance
findings.required_action: Preserve the scope statement. Do not cite PC PNG/GIF evidence as independent art review, physical-device, or human-readability acceptance.
findings.re_review_condition: Hardware acceptance requires the planned real-device execution and timing evidence; independent art review requires a separate image-inspection-capable reviewer.

findings.title: QualityGate central semantic lane remains unavailable
findings.required_action: Treat local QualityGate PASS and this independent review as the available gates; do not represent central semantic validation as complete.
findings.re_review_condition: A central semantic completion claim requires a current-fingerprint central result with agent_action.task_complete=true or equivalent provider completion.

Do not claim causal guard benefit, statistical 90% lower-bound passage, full-session adaptive acquisition, human timing, independent art review, physical-device acceptance, or central semantic completion.
Next package: guard causal counterfactual and scouting/transition AI; human three-key full-run timing; evolution preview/defer/lock.
residual_risks: The observed 93% natural-champion rate has a 95% Wilson lower bound of 86.25%, below 90%.
The measured anti-dive gain is attributable to the frozen species/formation/resources; selected guard produced no winner change versus learned-but-unselected guard.
Fixed squads and automatic timings do not estimate live acquisition frequency, full-session adaptive crafting/equipping, all-roster balance, or human operation duration.
The old formal v2 self-mirror expectation bug remains in archived JSON and is corrected by a separate current-probe identity diagnostic; formal matrices were not rerun under v3.
PC visual evidence was text/hash/test audited here and visually inspected by root; no independent art or hardware reviewer covered it.
Central MCP semantic validation and mutation testing were not executed; local QualityGate PASS and independent review do not replace those unavailable gates.
